title: Party Close to King Leads in Morocco’s Election as Young Voters Stay Away
summary_full: Early results in legislative elections showed the lowest voter turnout in nearly two decades. Economic frustrations have grown as Morocco is set to co-host the 2030 soccer World Cup.
